items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: what are you going to say with people like Betty Hutton, who was hot as a cracker at that time

ctx.x: And that was what attracted David, although he did know about you from before.

Yes. Well, as I say, this was what attracted him. This caused him to, you know, want to get in -- he heard me do the thing and so when he called, when I did talk with him, he told me he heard me on the show, and he says, "I was hoping that you'd get to do more." Said, "I want to hear you do more." And I says, "Well, I was just lucky." I really was.
